parse_rds <- function(f) { a <- attributes(readRDS(f)); list(gene=a"'$rownames, lfc=a$listData$log2FoldChange, padj=a$listData$padj) }
fs <- list.files("inputs", pattern="''^res_.*'"\\\\.rds"'$", full.names=TRUE)
rr <- lapply(fs, parse_rds)
ln <- readLines("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau", warn=FALSE)
sp <- strsplit(ln,"'"\\t\",fixed=TRUE)
map <- data.frame(gene=sub(\""'^pau:","",vapply(sp,`[`,"",1)),path=sub("''^path:","",vapply(sp,`[`,"",2)),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
sets <- lapply(split(map$gene,map$path),unique)
bg <- unique(map$gene)
calc <- function(r, dir, use_padj=FALSE, minGS=10, maxGS=500) {
  bg0 <- intersect(bg,r$gene)
  ss <- lapply(sets,intersect,y=bg0)
  keep <- lengths(ss)>=minGS & lengths(ss)<=maxGS
  ss <- ss[keep]
  selcrit <- if (dir=="up") r$lfc>1.5 else r$lfc < -1.5
  if (use_padj) selcrit <- selcrit & r$padj<.05
  sel <- intersect(r$gene[selcrit], bg0)
  N<-length(bg0); n<-length(sel); K<-lengths(ss); k<-vapply(ss,function(g)sum(sel%in%g),integer(1))
  p<-phyper(k-1,K,N-K,n,lower.tail=FALSE); adj<-p.adjust(p,"BH")
  data.frame(path=names(ss),K=K,k=k,p=p,adj=adj,n=n)
}
for (use_padj in c(FALSE,TRUE)) for (minGS in c(1,5,10)) for (maxGS in c(Inf,500)) {
  z <- lapply(rr,function(r) lapply(c("up","down"),function(d) calc(r,d,use_padj,minGS,maxGS)))
  for (cutname in c("p","adj")) for (cut in c(.01,.05,.1,.2)) for (di in c("up","down")) {
    sig<-lapply(z,function(a) { q<-a[[if(di=="up")1 else 2]][[cutname]]; a[[if(di=="up")1 else 2]]$path[q<cut] })
    inter<-Reduce(intersect,sig)
    if(length(inter)>0 || (cutname=="adj" && cut==.05 && minGS==10 && maxGS==500)) cat("padjgenes",use_padj,"min",minGS,"max",maxGS,"",cutname,cut,"dir",di,"n",paste(vapply(sig,length,integer(1)),collapse=","),"inter",length(inter),if(length(inter))paste(inter,collapse=","),"'"\\n\")
  }
}
RS"

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
files <- c(\"inputs/res_1vs97.rds\", \"inputs/res_1vs98.rds\", \"inputs/res_1vs99.rds\")
read_result <- function(f) {
  a <- attributes(readRDS(f))
  list(gene=a[[\"rownames\"]], lfc=a[[\"listData\"]][[\"log2FoldChange\"]])
}
res <- lapply(files, read_result)
links <- strsplit(readLines(\"https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau\", warn=FALSE), \"\\t\", fixed=TRUE)
map <- data.frame(
  gene=sub(\""'^pau:", "", vapply(links, `[`, "", 1)),
  path=sub("''^path:", "", vapply(links, `[`, "", 2)),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
term2gene <- lapply(split(map$gene, map$path), unique)
universe <- unique(map$gene)
ora <- function(x, direction) {
  genes <- intersect(universe, x$gene[if (direction == "up") x$lfc > 1.5 else x$lfc < -1.5])
  sets <- lapply(term2gene, intersect, y=universe)
  keep <- lengths(sets) >= 10 & lengths(sets) <= 500
  sets <- sets[keep]
  N <- length(universe); n <- length(genes); K <- lengths(sets)
  k <- vapply(sets, function(s) sum(genes %in% s), integer(1))
  p <- phyper(k - 1, K, N - K, n, lower.tail=FALSE)
  names(p)[p.adjust(p, method="BH") < 0.05]
}
sig_up <- lapply(res, ora, direction="up")
sig_down <- lapply(res, ora, direction="down")
common_up <- Reduce(intersect, sig_up)
common_down <- Reduce(intersect, sig_down)
cat("up counts:", paste(lengths(sig_up), collapse=","), "common:", length(common_up), "'"\\n\")
cat(\"down counts:\", paste(lengths(sig_down), collapse=\",\"), \"common:\", length(common_down), \"\\n\")
cat(\"answer:\", length(unique(c(common_up, common_down))), \"\\n\")
stopifnot(length(unique(c(common_up, common_down))) == 0)
RS"
